title: primula vulgaris subsp. calycantha
intro: Primula vulgaris subsp. calycantha, commonly known as the calycanthus primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Primulaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Primula vulgaris subsp. calycantha are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
